description: The classic master of the shadows that takes advantage of those who aren't looking.
The Viper knows how to coat any weapon in poisons that will make their enemies fall to their knees within minutes.
This little rascal has sticky fingers and use their enemies' powers against them.
This brickhouse will hit and not stop until their enemies are butt dust.
The Oakheart's veins flow with the blood of the forest and fills their muscles with the power to pull foes to their graves.
The Beast doesn't keep the two wolves inside of them locked away. They let them howl.

note: Additional Note: the Spellsword’s main mechanic is to generate Mana in combat by fight enemies. Mana can be spent to increase damage, heal targets, or cast Spells. The Spellsword can use any available weapon as a Focus for the sake of casting Spells. The Spellsword’s abilities usually cost X Mana, X being an amount of Mana up to the total amount they have generated in combat.
description: The Spellblade uses their momentum to harness the magical essence in the air around us and unleash it on their foes.
The Jugg take hit. The Jugg hit back. Hard.
This Knight of Death calls forth the power of the grave that beckons to its foes and pays the ferryman's toll with the blood of others.
This devout warrior channels the power of their deity to bring forth judgement upon their foes and to aid their friends in need.
The Crusade brought this warrior to the front and the front is where they plan to stay as they push the battleline further into enemy territory.
The Mirrormage, the Master of Illusions, uses trickery to command the battlefield and take down their enemies.
This psionic warrior disrupts the minds of its enemies to bring them to their knees.
This Master of Time takes advantage of their enemies' perception of time to extend to fight within themselves.
The Ninja uses smoke and shadows to evade their enemies and remain unseen as they turn the tide of the battle.

"Water. Earth. Fire. Air. Long ago, the four nations lived together in harmony. Then, everything changed when the Fire Nation attacked. Only the Avatar, master of all four elements, could stop them, but when the world needed him most, he vanished. A hundred years passed and my brother and I discovered the new Avatar, an airbender named Aang. And although his airbending skills are great, he has a lot to learn before he's ready to save anyone. But I believe Aang can save the world."
The Master don't take no back talk and he smack a foo'.

The Kindred, friend to the spirits, calls upon the Realm Beyond, to grant a companion that can aid them in combat.
As the Herald of Nature, the Druid seeks harmony between man and the flora and fauna throughout the realms.
